website.note: No /pipeline page (404). Site documents single product DeepView Wound Imaging System (multispectral imaging + AI) as 'CAUTION - INVESTIGATIONAL DEVICE' for diabetic foot ulcers, burn, and chronic wounds.

ctgov.additional_search: DeepView via clinicaltrials.gov API returned 6 SpectralMD-sponsored studies, all phase=N/A observational device-validation (NCT06131203, NCT05415683, NCT05023135, NCT06024512, NCT03611361 terminated, NCT05581966). None are interventional drug P1/P2/P3 trials.

lead_program.name: DeepView Wound Imaging System
lead_program.regulatory_status: FDA De Novo submission for burn indication; 164-patient (incl. 49 pediatric) validation study fully enrolled. Expected initial commercialization in the United Kingdom in 2026.
key_partnerships: BARDA Project BioShield (PBS) contract up to ~$150M; ~$54.9M initial award supporting clinical validation and FDA clearance
MTEC Agreement (~$4.9M) for handheld DeepView for military battlefield burn evaluation
registry_studies_completed_or_terminated: NCT05415683 Wound Assessment Spectral Imaging US (Completed, observational)
NCT05581966 Wound Assessment Spectral Imaging EU/UK (Completed, observational)

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Terminated observational device study (PAD amputation-level imaging).

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical-device / AI software-as-medical-device company. Lead program (DeepView Wound Imaging System for burn assessment) is at FDA De Novo submission stage; all sponsor-registered clinicaltrials.gov studies are observational device-validation (phase=N/A), not interventional P1/P2/P3. Per workflow rules for device companies, no active pivotal P1/P2/P3 drug or device interventional trial qualifies. Captured as commercial_product.
